description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Poison with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Machinist Mode I (Edgar - Poison)] and [Machinist Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Machinist Mode I (Edgar - Poison)
description.text: Machinist abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Machinist abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/2.50/3.00 for equipped Machinist abilities after using 1/2/3+ Machinist abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Machinist Mode II (Edgar - Poison)] to the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Machinist Mode II (Edgar - Poison)
description.text: Machinist abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Machinist abilities, casts Dual Boosted Voice after using Machinist abilities

description.name: Dual Boosted Voice
description.text: Grants [Dualcast Poison 1], [100% Critical 1] and [Buff Poison 10% (5s)]/[Triplecast Poison 1], [100% Critical 1] and [Buff Poison 20% (5s)]/[Quadracast Poison 1], [100% Critical 1] and [Buff Poison 30% (5s)] if any enemy has Imperil Poison 0-20%/30-40%/50%+ or is at 200% Poison weakness

description.name: Buff Poison 10% (5s)
description.text: Increases Poison damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Poison 20% (5s)
description.text: Increases Poison damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Poison 30% (5s)
description.text: Increases Poison damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Attach Poison with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Poison Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Poison 3
